title: Doors — Aft Cargo Door Surround — Installation of Thicker Longitudinal Splice Plates
abstract: Retrofit of the thicker aft cargo door surround splice plates and the denser fastener pattern on ZEPHYR-24 Evo aircraft delivered before the production cut-in, restoring the door closing effort to the published limit.

sections.planning_reason: ZEPHYR-24 Evo aircraft delivered before the production cut-in show more deflection at the aft cargo door surround than the original substantiation allowed at the cabin differential associated with the increased maximum take-off weight. Nine aircraft have reported a hard-to-close aft cargo door and two have reported a latch out-of-rig condition traced to surround deformation. Aircraft that are not modified remain on a halved door rigging check interval and will eventually load the latch hooks unevenly.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the longitudinal splice plates around the aft cargo door cut-out with items of increased gauge, adds an outboard angle at the aft lower corner to close the load path into the frame, and changes the fastener pattern along the upper and lower edges from a single row to a staggered double row.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the aft cargo door and put it on a padded stand. Remove the lining panels local to the cut-out from inside the aft cargo compartment. Do a detailed visual inspection of the surround and record any deformation before removal. Remove the superseded intercostal D5230111892105 and the existing splice plates. Ream the fastener holes to the pattern of drawing D52301146738 and do an eddy current inspection of each reamed hole. Install the stringer D5230114751500 and the outboard angle JA880258-89 with the edging grommet AES686504-33 where the wiring route crosses the new fastener line. Fit the thicker splice plates and fasten the staggered double row wet. Install the door, rig it to the values in the accomplishment instructions and measure the closing effort. Install the lining panels and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZPH-24N3 and ZPH-24N7 aircraft that have not been built to the reinforced surround standard. Aircraft delivered from the production cut-in onward are already modified and must not be re-worked. This bulletin does not apply to any ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20 or ZEPHYR-22 aircraft, nor to ZEPHYR-24 aircraft of the classic weight variants, whose door surround carries a different substantiation.
sections.material_note: Kit K5230-1076-01 contains the splice plates, the stringer, the outboard angle, the grommet and the fastener set for one door. Lead time is twenty weeks. The removed intercostal is returned to Aeralis for metallurgical sampling on the first ten embodiments only.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled door overhaul, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
